title: Concept Artist
author: veyravoss
selftext:
Hi everyone, I am a hobbyist starting out focusing mostly on characters, weapons and environmental pre-production using open-source AI for the concepts although can sketch if needed. I love jumping around between genres (like futuristic one day, fantasy the next).   
  
Do developers here find it useful to see standalone concept art and ideas for game inspiration, or do you prefer full design concept style art documents? Or ideas where I can post them if AI generated? Thank you.

comments.author: radiantforce
comments.body:
For me the idea of the game mechanic came first, and the theme around it second.  
This is my game: [https://radiantforce.itch.io/grid](https://radiantforce.itch.io/grid)

I don't have design skillsets and had to use AI to generate the cover image.

replies.author: veyravoss
replies.body: Ok thank you, so art/design after which makes sense. The cover image looks great, mine would be more realism although can do any art style. Just wasn't sure whether this was the right sub to share a few ideas I have.

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: Would love to hear ideas. In fact, commented to see if there was a realm where you would want to make a cover for my game. I’d keep your credit, watermark and attribution in the image title of course.

replies.author: veyravoss
replies.body: Thank you, I am just starting out really so it would be characters or scenery not full cover etc

replies.author: radiantforce
replies.body: Thank u for letting me know :)

replies.author: veyravoss
replies.body:
No problem for your game for example I could bring them to life i.e girl on your cover with cape etc like this or make them in different art style like you done.

https://preview.redd.it/1rqj0yjg3fbh1.jpeg?width=889&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=ce93919e95b38f3094f54200b1141ee5b63fac45

comments.author: Happy_Variety5405
comments.body: What makes someone that wants to “just make a game” and someone that wants to make a game is Inspiration. The game idea should always come first and you should design everything around what you want to make. For mine I always had an idea for vector based game like old arcade games for years and I loved arena shooters before they died as a genre so I combined the 2 ideas and slowly built the game around that

replies.author: veyravoss
replies.body: So it is more game ideas in this sub and not art / ai art concepts.
